_comment: Per-test kept-red expectation manifest (required since #1806 r11 — the runner fails loud when a declared proof lacks it). The declared test MUST fail with an AssertionError on correct code.

expectedRed.testName: the declaredProofTests function has a single try block covering BOTH git rev-parse and git fetch --unshallow, whose catch names git rev-parse (the buggy structure the fix corrected)
expectedRed.why: On correct code each command has its own try/catch, so bugPresent is false and `expect(bugPresent).toBe(true)` fails with an AssertionError. If this test passes, the structural fix regressed to a single try block whose catch names rev-parse.
